titre: L'hypertriglycéridémie sévère est peu connue et presque pas traitée

series.nom: Part des adultes avec HTG sévère

Conscients de leur cholestérol élevé.texte: Only 56% of the individuals with SHTG were aware of having high cholesterol.

Hypertension.texte: More than 14% of those with SHTG reported having diabetes mellitus, and 31.3% reported having hypertension.

Sous statines.texte: Only 14% of the subjects with SHTG reported using statins, and 4.0% reported using fibrates.
